author: CBR
description:
Jason Aaron explains why Absolute Superman feels darker: Kal-El arrives on Earth as a teenager with memories, relationships, and an identity, then loses it all. That trauma fuels an angrier, edgier Superman and reframes his Kryptonian ideals, immigrant identity, and search for belonging in the Absolute Universe.

🎙️ Clip from CBR’s Heroes Journey Podcast – Episode 14.
